ambiguities: NaN propagation applied literally everywhere: e.g. pace_s is NaN when pace20 is NaN (n20 < 3, including n20 = 0 where 0*NaN = NaN); off_s/def_s are NaN when E(ppp/dpp;20,3) is NaN even if g40 = 0; all league quantities are NaN on the first date (empty set) so every dependent column is NaN there.

E(x;H,m): rows grouped per team in (date) order across all seasons; shift(1) within the team, then ewm(halflife=H, min_periods=m).mean() with pandas defaults; NaN x values (e.g. adj) are left in the series.
margin is recomputed as pts - opp_pts from the row (not read from the file's margin column); win = pts > opp_pts.
o_X is looked up via (game_id, opp_team_id) in the regular-row universe.
rb_sd_pre, ot_sd_margin/total/corr use running sums over home rows of all dates strictly before d (dates taken over the whole regular team table).
rb_st_close_pre / rb_st_blow_pre: close/blowout classified by the team's own |margin| of the earlier game; count threshold applies to games with non-NaN st_reg.
st_min is NaN when no played & started regular player row exists for (game_id, team_id); otherwise the sum of minutes.
fm_*: Z(d) built only from home rows whose own rb_mu_pre and rb_sd_pre are non-NaN; requires len(Z(d)) >= 200; strict inequalities; share = count/len(Z(d)).
pace20: 'last up to 20 earlier games' = the team's 20 most recent earlier regular rows across seasons; weights normalised by their own sum (weighted mean).
g40 and k (lineup) count the team's earlier regular rows in team_games across all seasons.
ot_sd_team_pre: uncentred RMS of resid over the team's earlier games with non-NaN resid, needs >= 10.
ot_corr_mt_pre: corr = mean(rm*rt)/(sd_m*sd_t), uncentred, NaN when n < 100; sign flipped for away rows.

tm_resid_bin_pre: bin = floor(ot_exp_margin_pre/2) clipped to [-8,7] using the row's own value; S and N accumulate over all rows (home+away) of earlier dates whose own bin equals b and whose resid is non-NaN; NaN only if own bin undefined.

eo_*: ppf/ppa NaN when the team has no regular rows in season sidx-1, making eo_exp_wins_pre and eo_surprise_pre NaN; eo_proj_wins_pre then NaN only while gp < 5 (cur = pyth(pf,pa) once gp >= 5). pyth with zero inputs cannot arise for gp >= 5.
ws_run_pre resets at each (team, sidx); ws_p20_pre computed by the stated recursion R = max(82-gp,0) times and read at r = ws_run_pre; 1 if run >= 20.

lineup: 'player rows' need played == True and minutes > 0 (regular). Window games are the team's previous min(30,k) rows of team_games; games with no player rows contribute nothing. A = players with a player row (played, minutes > 0) for T in T's immediately preceding team_games row; players of A all have M_i > 0 since that game is in the window. Top-8 ties broken by numerically smaller nba_id (ids can be negative; plain numeric comparison). Players considered for Ibar/top8 are those with M_i > 0 rows in the window.
I(i,d) uses the player's rows on all teams and seasons with date strictly before the team row's date d (not before the window games' dates).
TABLE 2 output sorted by (date, game_id, nba_id); output column team = nba_id.
team_gp: number of distinct game_ids among all regular player_games rows (played or not) of the row's team_id and sidx with date strictly earlier than the row's date.
prev(X) is 0 when the player has no universe rows in season sidx-1 (so Gp = Mp = 0).
srp: r0 falls back to lg36(d) when Mp < 200; lg36 is NaN on the first date so srp_* is NaN there.
ag_proj: computed as (cur + R*mu)/(G+R), NaN if G+R == 0; NaN if mu is NaN (prior NaN on the first date) even if R were 0. ag_avg is NaN when G = 0.
pm_proj_pre is NaN when mpg is NaN (G = 0 and Gp = 0) even if R = 0 (literal NaN propagation); pm_todate_pre is 0 with no earlier rows this season; pm_rate_pre is 0 with no career rows.
rm: rm_3pa36_pre NaN if wmin <= 0; rm_lambda_pre and rm_p_any_pre NaN whenever rm_3pa36_pre or mpg2 is NaN, even if R = 0.
avail = min(1, G/team_gp) where G counts the player's earlier universe rows this season on any team; R = max(82-team_gp,0)*avail (not rounded).
CSV floats written with %.17g; NaN as empty cells; integer-valued features (ws_run_pre, pm_todate_pre) are written as floats.
